description.value: Saanich Commonwealth Place is a large municipal aquatic and fitness centre operated by the District of Saanich, anchored by a 50-metre competition pool alongside a wave pool, tots pool, dive tank, and water slide — one of the most comprehensive aquatic complexes on Vancouver Island. The facility also offers a steam room, sauna, hot tub, weight room, gymnasium, and functional fitness studio, giving touring cyclists a rare opportunity to recover thoroughly after a long day on the road. It sits near Elk Lake, a popular cycling destination in its own right, making it a natural stop on routes through the Saanich Peninsula.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The facility page at saanich.ca confirms the address (4636 Elk Lake Drive) and phone (250-475-7600), both absent or unset in OSM. The website lists specific amenities directly: competition pool (50m), wave pool, tots pool, dive tank/tower, steam room, sauna, hot tub, water slide, weight room, aerobic/dance studio, gymnasium, multi-purpose rooms, and a pro shop — but makes no explicit mention of bike parking, racks, showers by name, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null per the evidence-only rule. The service status is 'Operating as scheduled' as of May 18 2026, confirming the facility is open.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The facility is a legitimate, operating public aquatic and fitness centre with strong recovery appeal for touring cyclists (pools, steam room, sauna, hot tub), but none of the three required WWC criteria — bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms — could be confirmed from the website. A direct visit or phone inquiry to verify at least bike parking and washrooms would resolve the listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: A facility of this size (50m competition pool, multiple aquatic zones, weight room, gymnasium) almost certainly has change rooms with showers and washrooms, but the website does not list them explicitly. A phone call to 250-475-7600 or a site visit would likely confirm several null criteria quickly.
